title: Sunday · the motel at Christmas
logline: The motel from 101 in December: a string of lights on the office, one car in the lot, the ice machine's glow, and in the last tier the desk from the lot with a small tree on it and a man behind it not looking up. The hum line under the page.

panels.composition: Tier 1: a small motel from the highway at night with a string of colored lights on its office and one car in the lot.

image.prompt: a small roadside motel at night with a string of colored lights along its office roofline and one car in the lot, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Lights

panels.composition: Tier 2: the ice machine in the breezeway, its blue glow, a wreath on the vending machine.

image.prompt: an ice machine glowing blue in a motel breezeway with a wreath hung on the vending machine beside it, watercolor

panels.name: Ice

panels.composition: Tier 3: the office from the lot through glass: a small tree on the desk, a man in a maroon polo behind it, head down, a thin line beneath.

image.prompt: a motel office seen through its glass door from the lot with a small tinsel tree on the desk and a man in a maroon polo behind it with his head down, a thin horizontal line beneath the image, watercolor

panels.name: Desk

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: The hum line under the motel. A tree on the desk.
